limitations: Shrink pass ran in its inline form (documentation-only diff): nothing removed, because the file is a reviewed staged copy installed byte-for-byte so the review bookkeeping can match it; every added rule traces to an ACTIONED observation in the archived task-observer log
reason: The live pytest-suite skill had not changed since 2026-08-10, and it let two kinds of test pass without proving anything: a regression test passed identically before and after its fix because the convenience harness never entered the argv path the bug lived in (observation 10), and ten green tests ran against a hand-written fake whose return shapes did not match the real backend (15). rollback: git revert restores the previous skill text. The staged source copy stays outside the repository at ~/.claude/skill-updates/2026-08-30/pytest-suite and is not touched by a revert
